Documentation.short_help: SHYX Partitioned Collection To OpenFOAM: Write polyMesh from volume + side sets.
Documentation.long_help: Takes a vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection with an IOSS-style volume block (element_blocks) and side sets. Writes constant/polyMesh, system/{controlDict,fvSchemes,fvSolution}, 0/p and 0/U (zeroGradient on every PDC side-set name; names are not rewritten to inlet/outlet/wall), plus volume PointData/CellData as 0/shyx_<array> volFields. OpenFOAM cannot store NaN. PointData is averaged only when every vertex is finite; any NaN among a face's vertices writes 0 (no one-cell bleed). Node sets are ignored. Selection Append Patches cannot be written as polyMesh. Output is vtkOpenFOAMReader's vtkMultiBlockDataSet.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection from SHYX DataSet To Partitioned Collection (volume UnstructuredGrid + side sets). Selection Append Patches is not supported.

StringVectorProperty.name: VolumeArrayStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Arrays to write
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Volume PointData and CellData written as 0/shyx_<name>. Uncheck to skip. GlobalIds, PedigreeIds, and vtk* arrays are omitted. Default: all eligible arrays on.

StringVectorProperty.name: CaseDirectory
StringVectorProperty.label: Case Directory
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Root of the OpenFOAM case. Leave empty to write under %TEMP%/shyx-pdc-of-<id>-<mtime>/case. Writes constant/polyMesh, system/, 0/, and case.foam.

StringVectorProperty.name: CaseFoamPath
StringVectorProperty.label: Case Folder
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: After Apply: the folder actually written. Empty Case Directory uses a new unique %TEMP%/shyx-pdc-of-*/case. Read-only; use the folder button to open it.

IntVectorProperty.name: AllowDefaultFaces
IntVectorProperty.label: Allow Default Faces
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If enabled, volume boundary faces not claimed by any side set are written as Default Faces Name (type wall). Default off: Apply fails when any exterior face is unassigned.

StringVectorProperty.name: DefaultFacesName
StringVectorProperty.label: Default Faces Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Patch name for leftover boundary faces when Allow Default Faces is on.
